terms_body_0: SafaRoll identifies the animals you photograph and turns them into collectible cards. You retain ownership of your photos. By publishing a deck, you agree that other players can see it, along with your display name and the cards it contains.
terms_body_1: Zero tolerance. Nudity and sexual content, violence, hate, harassment, impersonation, spam and any photo that isn't yours are prohibited. Content that violates these rules is removed, and the account that published it may be suspended without notice.
terms_body_2: You can report any public deck or profile — long-press a deck or use the ⋯ button on a player's profile. Every report is reviewed within 24 hours, and the content is removed if it violates these rules. You can also block a player: their decks, profile and name disappear from the community, and they can no longer add you. You can find and unblock blocked accounts in your profile.
terms_body_3: Your captures, collection and decks belong to you. Deleting your account from your profile deletes everything — including photos — without retention.
terms_body_4: For questions, urgent reports or deletion requests: {{contact}}.
